title: Lewis Structure Studio
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Interactive chemistry study game for building Lewis structures, determining VSEPR geometry, and practicing bond and molecular polarity. CHEM 3A and CHEM 1A include valence-electron counting, multiple central atoms, octet exceptions, and resonance practice. CHEM 3B uses bonding trends and adds expanded structures, condensed structural formulas, and skeletal formula drawing with functional-group and iso/sec/tert practice sets. Includes 174 structures, shuffled practice, subscripts and ionic charges, draggable atoms, bond and lone-pair tools, cleanup and undo, classroom VSEPR and electronegativity references, embedded PhET Molecule Shapes exploration, hints, answer reveals, prominent correct/incorrect feedback, scoring, streaks, celebration animations, and a responsive pastel interface.
